actions_per_group 6dddc1b7cb0e.sql:
-- Actions are the views and product events sent with a group_id.
SELECT CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT group_id) > 0
            THEN ROUND(count(*)::DOUBLE / count(DISTINCT group_id), 1) ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM events
WHERE project_id = 1 AND family IN ('views', 'product') AND group_id <> ''
  AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10'

consent_share 3dc14ce32ff2.sql:
-- Visitors are distinct per day and consent state, added up. A view sent
-- without $consent is unknown and left out of the rate.
WITH d AS (
  SELECT consent, count(DISTINCT actor_id) AS visitors
  FROM views
  WHERE project_id = 1
    AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
    AND consent IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY day, consent
)
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(visitors) > 0
            THEN COALESCE(SUM(visitors) FILTER (WHERE consent = 1), 0)::DOUBLE / SUM(visitors)
       END AS value
FROM d
